title: Architecture of a payments platform
summary: A payments platform with data bottlenecks and business logic spread across services without a clear pattern.
challengeSummary: A payments platform with data bottlenecks and business logic spread across services without a clear pattern.
challengeDetails: Charging and reconciliation decisions were spread across services with no clear owner. Each data incident took days to trace.
approach: An architecture assessment, the design of the payments data flow and technical risk governance.

approachSteps.body: Trace a payment from end to end and find where the logic is duplicated.
Define an owner for each data item and an explicit event flow between the charging and reconciliation services.
Technical risk tracking with owners and a review of each decision about data.

solution: A data model with an owner per domain and an explicit reconciliation flow, introduced in phases without stopping payments.
outcomes: Easier maintenance of the business logic
deliverables: Solution architecture design for the data flow

seo.title: Architecture of a payments platform | Representative case
seo.description: Representative scenario: how a payments platform with unowned data and distributed logic is put in order, and with which services.
